description: Size: material-specific coagulation slopes (material x ln(1+K N0 t)), ridge-shrunk

model.formula: y_j = ridge(material one-hot + ln(1 + K N0 t) + no_flow + 5(Rt/R0-1.35) + material x ln(1+K N0 t)), K N0 = 3.75e-3/s (x0.1 no-flow); Dg, AMD via Hatch-Choate; detection: P_j = beta-binomial rate in (flow, material, aged) -> (flow, material) -> flow regime -> global, a=2
model.notes: Ridge on log Dm, ln sigma_g, log M0; Dg and AMD derived by Hatch-Choate. Per-target alpha by GCV; logistic C by inner 5-fold Brier.
